MonitoringProgramDescription: Most of the Tahoe Region's water arrives as winter snow, which melts slowly into streams and the lake through spring and summer. As the climate warms, more of it falls as rain, runs off sooner, and leaves less snowpack for the dry season.
MonitoringApproach: The Central Sierra Snow Laboratory near Donner Pass, just outside the Basin, has a daily record of precipitation and snowfall from 1970. Totals here are by calendar year. The share falling as snow comes from the same record.
